slides.look: A mustard velvet sectional layered with tangerine linen pillows, a low walnut coffee table, a cream geometric wool rug, stacked art books, and a tall brushed-brass floor lamp beside an oversized fiddle-leaf fig in a terracotta pot.

slides.text: soft sage and blush feels like a deep breath
slides.look: An oatmeal bouclé sofa accented with dusty rose cushions, an oval travertine coffee table, a sage green jute rug, an arch floor lamp with a pleated shade, botanical gallery prints, and a tall potted olive tree.

slides.text: cobalt blue turns up the energy
slides.look: A royal blue low-profile sofa, a glossy chrome coffee table, a checkered black-and-ivory rug, colorful abstract canvas art, a red metal mushroom table lamp, and ceramic sculptural vases filled with eucalyptus branches on a natural oak sideboard.

slides.text: warm rust tones bring the cozy glow
slides.look: A rust linen three-seater sofa with olive corduroy throw pillows, a round fluted oak coffee table, an amber glass globe floor lamp, a woven distressed kilim rug, and framed landscape prints resting on a sleek credenza.

slides.text: lilac and butter yellow belong together
slides.look: A pale lilac curved sofa paired with buttercup yellow velvet cushions, a wavy glass coffee table, a wavy pastel border rug, a chrome dome lamp, stacked indie magazines, and vibrant floral art in thin silver frames.

slides.text: deep emerald gives that collected parlor feel
slides.look: A deep emerald velvet tufted sofa with gold satin cushions, a smoked glass and brass coffee table, an antique-inspired faded Persian runner, an ornate gilded mirror leaning behind a sculptural paper floor lamp, and brass candlesticks.

plan.cta_look: A soft peach sectional piled with powder blue wool throws, a birch ply coffee table holding ceramic mugs, a braided off-white wool rug, framed minimalist sketches, and an airy paper lantern pendant lamp.

slides.text: sun-drenched mustard 70s retro

plan.hook: done with my dorm looking like a hostel! 😅

slides.text: olive corduroy makes a twin bed feel grounded
slides.look: An olive green corduroy duvet with ochre bolster cushions, a rounded birchwood desk topped with a mushroom lamp, a wavy checkered wool rug, framed vintage botanical prints, and a potted monstera on a brass plant stand.

slides.text: tomato red and cobalt together just hit right
slides.look: A cobalt blue washed linen duvet paired with a tomato red throw blanket, a red metal task lamp, geometric graphic art prints, a cream shag runner, and a sleek chrome rolling cart stacked with art books.

slides.text: plum velvet turns tiny spaces moody and plush
slides.look: A deep plum velvet quilt layered with dusty rose lumbar pillows, an antique brass desk lamp, an ornate arched standing mirror, an intricate Persian wool runner, and tall dark oak book ledges packed with paperbacks.

slides.text: sun-baked terracotta warms up any cold corner
slides.look: A terracotta linen duvet layered with a marigold knit throw, a woven jute rug, a paper lantern pendant light, framed desert landscape sketches, and a mini travertine side table holding a glazed ceramic water carafe.

slides.text: butter yellow makes every morning feel lighter
slides.look: A buttery yellow quilted comforter topped with ruffled gingham pillows, a mint green bentwood desk chair, a striped pastel flatweave rug, framed abstract pastel lithographs, and a scalloped ceramic table lamp.

slides.text: glossy chrome cuts right through sleepy clutter

plan.cta_look: A forest green velvet bedspread with lilac linen cushions, a wavy floor mirror reflecting a brass pharmacy lamp, a plush Moroccan diamond rug, and floating ash-wood shelves stacked with trailing pothos and ceramics.

slides.text: raw earthy japandi
slides.look: Bleached oak flat-front cabinets with invisible notch pulls, honed limestone counters, and ribbed ceramic splashback. Two sculptural paper lantern pendants hang over dark ash barstools, paired with stacked stoneware bowls and a single dried branch in an unglazed vessel.
slides.callout: obsessed with this paper pendant

slides.text: soft organic japandi
slides.look: Matte sand cabinets with subtle brass finger pulls, rounded quartz countertops, and cream ceramic backsplash tiles. Slender rattan-back counter stools tuck beneath the island beneath an oversized woven washi paper dome, styled with hand-pinched tea cups and a linen runner.
slides.callout: obsessed with this woven pendant light

slides.text: monochrome minimal japandi
slides.look: Matte charcoal cabinet fronts paired with pale white oak worktops and a thin basalt splashback. Curved black bentwood stools sit under sleek suspended bamboo cylinder pendants, accented by matte black iron canisters and white speckled ceramic bowls on open shelving.
slides.callout: love this black cane stool

slides.text: warm timber japandi
slides.look: Rich honey oak slab cabinets, beige travertine worktops, and glossy beige zellige tiles. Low-backed woven rush counter stools rest by the counter, illuminated by a pleated rice paper shade, with a carved wooden matcha bowl and small olive branch.
slides.callout: obsessed with this paper pendant light

slides.text: serene rustic japandi
slides.look: Muted sage-grey cabinetry with dark walnut open shelves, white speckled terrazzo counters, and handmade chalk-white splashback. Weathered teak stools pair with a duo of ribbed glass globe pendants, accompanied by heavy wabi-sabi clay jars and natural linen tea towels.
slides.callout: need this rustic wooden stool

slides.text: sculptural modern japandi
slides.look: Pale ash cabinets with hidden edge pulls, warm grey soapstone counters, and vertical fluted tile splashback. Minimalist cast iron counter stools sit under an asymmetrical Akari-inspired pendant light, styled with dark stoneware teapots and a textured ivory ceramic vase.
slides.callout: love this pleated pendant light

plan.cta_look: Smoked oak cabinets with brushed brass edge pulls, honed ivory composite counters, and ivory tile splashback. Black spindle counter stools sit beneath an airy silk lantern pendant, styled with coarse ceramic planters and rough stone serving boards.
